component.name: TrayPlay
component.summary: Virtual microconsole in the system tray

description.p: TrayPlay is an ultra-lightweight virtual microconsole living directly in your desktop system tray. It features an embedded retro game canvas, sandboxed Lua runtime, 60 FPS fixed-timestep loop, chiptune audio synthesizer, and zero background resource consumption when not in use.
Initial release with embedded retro games, GNOME Shell frontend, and on-demand lifecycle.
